name: Marine Diesel Engine
tagline: Independent marine diesel information for Australia
description: Independent Australian guides to marine diesel engines, faults, service costs and how to find a marine mechanic. We do not sell repairs.
_comment_publishing: defaultAuthor is the publishing organisation and is a legitimate byline. defaultReviewer must be a real, named, licensed marine mechanic — never a placeholder. Until it is set, pillars and symptom/engine pages stay noindex and out of the sitemap, because those carry direct diagnostic and safety advice. Service pages publish on the author byline alone.
defaultAuthor: The Marine Diesel Engine editorial team
_comment_domain: Must match the host actually served. The apex 308-redirects to www in production, so canonicals, Open Graph URLs and every sitemap entry use www — otherwise each one costs a redirect hop and the canonical points at a URL that is not the one served.
_comment_staticRoutes: Pages built from .astro rather than content/. They are real URLs and must appear in the sitemap — the homepage is the most important URL on the site and was previously absent from it entirely.
